lede: I am a theorist working on the nonlinear dynamics of driven-dissipative optical systems: cavity solitons and frequency combs, multimode and spatiotemporal light in optical fibres, and the quantum-limited noise that sets the coherence of both. My work combines bifurcation theory, reduced analytical models and large-scale numerics, and is developed in close contact with the experimental groups that build these cavities and fibres.

funding.lede: I have been awarded two consecutive Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowships as sole applicant — BEAMLOCKER (call 2021, Sapienza University of Rome) followed directly by ENLIGHTENS (call 2023, Université libre de Bruxelles) — which is rare: the scheme is highly competitive, each proposal was written and defended by me alone, and the second was won while the first was still running. Together with a Sapienza supplementary Marie Curie award and an earlier Sapienza Campus Grant, this has funded my research continuously since 2021.
